title: Helpful to a Fault: Measuring Illicit Assistance in Multi-Turn, Multilingual LLM Agents
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating 'illicit assistance' and 'misuse' of LLM agents across harmful scenarios. It specifically benchmarks the models' adherence to safety and moral boundaries by employing a Refusal Checker that identifies refusals based on 'safety, ethical, or legal grounds' and evaluates 'harmful behavioral prompts' such as drug sales.
